title: E8 prefix restoration and heterogeneous helper banks: conditional kappa = 1.000220222889528e-3
body:
**Conditional κ = 125027527861191 / 125000000000000000 = 1.000220222889528 × 10⁻³.** This is approximately **0.1981% above #382**, the strongest benchmark in the frozen sweep through #383, and passes the 0.001 threshold.

Adds the self-contained `research/e8-prefix-restoration/` package. The gain comes from two explicit new changes to the complex supplier: **18 target-prefix difference/recovery rewrites**, followed by **early helper restoration through dirty preconditioning and heterogeneous endpoint banks**. The bit-side headroom composes existing #376 and #381 mechanisms and is credited as such.

## Exact assembly

| Quantity | Exact value | Decimal |
|---|---|---:|
| Complex coarse saving b | 40048866680681 / 40000000000000000 | 0.001001221667017025 |
| Bit coarse saving c | 255384852701747 / 250000000000000000 | 0.001021539410806988 |
| Assembled κ | 125027527861191 / 125000000000000000 | **0.001000220222889528** |

The complex side binds. Both exact rational moment engines, the inherited fallback, adjacent-grid exclusions and all **47 strict outer assembly inequalities** are checked. Gains are composed by rebuilding and pricing the resulting program; percentage gains are never added.

| Successive construction | κ |
|---|---:|
| #381 benchmark | 0.000995656966441037 |
| #382 / old compressed-complex cap | 0.000998243154231047 |
| #376 helper reuse in #381, with #378 far-retimed complex word | 0.000998634656132003 |
| Add the 18 new target-prefix rewrites | 0.001000197726610570 |
| Add early restoration and heterogeneous banks | **0.001000220222889528** |

Our first composition merely reached the already-public #382 cap. That is not presented as a discovery.

## New mechanism 1: target-prefix recovery

For each of18 disjoint target pairs, initialize `yi -= yj`, deliver the difference of their actual versioned prefix responses, then restore `yi += yj` at a legal common-frame cut. All helper visits remain charged. Exact rational replay proves equality of the entire raw operator on all1023 independent columns, including arbitrary dirty targets and783 helpers.

The local paid histogram changes by `{1:-5, 2:-5, 3:-4, 4:-6, 6:-9, 7:+15}`. Removed and added rank mass are both105. For every exponent0<p<1, the ratio r^(p-1) strictly decreases, so moving this mass from ranks below7 into rank7 strictly improves the paid moment.

These are target-to-target additions, which the old local compiler excluded. The package supplies the explicit sufficient extension: retain the original response/cleanup network because the full raw operator and helper dynamics are unchanged; emit the new additions at their common frames; check both chronological dirty orientations and all changed Gaussian phases.

## New mechanism 2: dirty preconditioning permits unequal helper endpoints

For the changed main word, write `(x,h,y) -> (x,Nx+Ah,y+Mx+Bh)`. Before the main, perform **target cancellation `y -= B A^-1 h` first**, then helper preconditioning `h <- A^-1 h`. The inverse is an emitted reverse sequence of elementary helper shears, not an assumed recovery oracle. After the main, subtract `Nx` only from helpers whose clean row is nonzero.

Two exact zero rows allow helpers355 and403 to finish at rank8 rather than FULL rank9. Their literal uncomputes are:

```
h355 -= h356; h355 += h556/2; h355 += h619
h403 -= h409; h403 += h577/2; h403 += h628
```

Every donor advance is paid. The joint local change is `{1:+2,3:+4,4:-4}` with rank mass -2. The scalar pre/post network is explicit; the literal coefficient compiler handles numerator3 and denominator4 and charges **165748 real-component primitives per orientation**.

With32 replicas, each stage has64 rank8 and24992 rank9 residuals. Eight width73 banks hold `8×8 + 9`;3123 other banks hold `8×9 + 1 paid padding`. This gives3131 banks/stage,58899 live families,59692 physical families, rank mass4289643 and deficit9984.

The geometric details are included rather than treated as free: full rank8 endpoint permutation/translation/Z4-phase adapters; actual inverse owner routes `d A^-1` (14 of16 routes are nonsymmetric); all25056 assignments;288 local invocations;576 endpoint adapters;28107 padding calls; the inherited all-live cover correction. Both forward and inverse-adjoint local programs are checked.

Full upstream authorship and licenses are preserved in the vendored notices. Exact heads are in `SOURCE-PINS.json`. Credits do not imply endorsement. There is no claim that elementary linear preconditioning itself is globally novel; the contribution is its explicit legal use here, the new prefix rewrite and the resulting paid supplier improvement.

## Reproduce and validation scope

Requires Python3.11+, NumPy2.4.6, SymPy1.14.0, mpmath1.3.0, g++ with C++17, and Boost multiprecision headers. Set `CXX` or `BOOST_INCLUDE` if needed.

```sh
python -m pip install -r research/e8-prefix-restoration/requirements.txt
python -B research/e8-prefix-restoration/verify.py /absolute/path/to/fresh-output
```

Use a nonexistent output directory outside the package and do not use Python `-O`. The replay is offline and checks the packaged construction, not unchanged public verification pipelines. Preserve file bytes (`git -c core.autocrlf=false clone ...` on systems that otherwise rewrite line endings), because the manifest binds exact source bytes.

A fresh packaged replay passed all12 top-level stages in about304 seconds (Windows, Python3.11.9); exact source hashes and the replay receipt are available. The output includes full dirty-column checks, private erasures, exact canonical Clifford phases, bank geometry and inverse routes, explicit literal/global templates, bit bridge and witness controls, finite invoices and the final rational assembly receipt. The complex row coefficient15449 and the bit internal reserve10370 fit within the inherited20161 bound. Failing omission controls test concrete faults; they are not a completeness proof for the checker.

**This remains a conditional finite construction.** It retains #370/#377/#381's all-size local theorem, nine-centre bit interfaces, non-paired-family banks, degree-two bit row treatment, compressed-window, compiler, common-grid, precision and analytic assumptions. It is not a Lean certification or a new unconditional integer-multiplication theorem. No exhaustive astronomical cover evaluation is claimed.

## Research record for future work

`research-notes/ROUND.md`, `PRIOR-ROUND.md` and the detailed sufficient proofs preserve both the successful route and bounded negative screens: exact signed-support cancellation, recursive predecessor moves, mixed frame intervals/pairs, crossed far relocation, replica/padding profiles, shared-axis banks and helper-lifetime candidates. Rejected invoices are not included in the claimed exponent. Targeted structural DAG retrieval informed composition and cancellation; it is not claimed as an exhaustive search or a certificate.

The reusable next route is to search for more zero clean rows with lower-dimensional endpoints, jointly charging donor advances, preconditioning, endpoint phases, owner inverses and heterogeneous padding. Broader disjoint target-prefix bases are another candidate. Neither is priced into this result without a complete witness.
